schema_description: Resolved bootstrap-CI metadata sidecar for leaderboard_all_evaluations.json (combined / cross-architecture, Era 2).
notes: Era 2 combined / cross-architecture leaderboard. Pools all 87 conditions across 4 architectures (single-pass=6, consensus=29, single-pass+PV=8, pv=44) into a single greedy-clique BH-FDR-tiered ranking, separately at each (buffer, metric, q-level) combination. Within-architecture pairwise tests reused from per-architecture caches at results/leaderboard/per-architecture/era2/<arch>/.cache/; only cross-architecture pairs (2,346 per buffer) computed fresh. See results/leaderboard/combined/README.md for methodology.
